Under the ruling (wrong basis counts OPEN) a plain ON=OFF match would not count; here the equation itself is proved across the two configurations, which is the stronger statement. gate body with wrapping_ operators vs fresh checked, no overflow-freedom argument found: CONFIG_MISMATCH, OPEN. NJA_CountBody (6) and the NFN closure/for_range family (11) are in this class. Counterexample candidates (not claimed reachable): NFN closure_4.closure call_mut computes `5#usize * i + tupled_args`; for i >= 2^64/5 the fresh body fails with an arithmetic-overflow error where the gate wraps. The caller domain of i (query index in QueryGeometry.for_range) was not proved bounded in this job.
